notes.title: Build Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We apologize for any inconvenience we may have caused, as the final build wasn't pushed at the time of release.

Rest assured the game now has the latest version as of this posting.
To report bugs/typos and other errors, please post them here.

Please note that existing saves will be wiped after updating the game. 
Apologies again for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,

The Muv-Luv Team
